# Manuel Carlevaro

> Physicist specializing in computational modeling and simulation of many-particle systems, with applications to granular matter, confined fluids, molecular biophysics and complex systems.

Positions:

- Independent Researcher, CONICET, at the Instituto de Física de Líquidos y Sistemas Biológicos (IFLYSIB, CONICET-UNLP); head of the Statistical Mechanics of Liquids and Soft Condensed Matter group.
- Full Professor, Universidad Tecnológica Nacional, Facultad Regional La Plata; director of the Centro de Investigación en Mecánica Experimental y Computacional (CIMEC).

The site is bilingual: Spanish at the root, English under /en/.

Methods: Molecular dynamics, Discrete element method (DEM, CFD–DEM), Monte Carlo, Liquid-state theory, Genetic algorithms, Neural networks.
Research lines: granular matter, confined fluids, molecular biophysics, complex systems.
